Master of Arts in Teaching

  • You are here →

  Download Catalog as PDF

The mission of the Master of Arts in Teaching degree is to provide an alternate pathway to earn teaching credentials. Often, people earn a bachelor's degree in a content-field, then for a variety of reasons, decide they would like to enter the teaching profession. The state of Kentucky does not provide a pathway for people to obtain licensure simply by passing certification exams. Therefore, the Master of Arts in Teaching provides a pathway for qualified candidates to complete the requirements for licensure, while at the same time providing them the option to be hired as teachers in Kentucky schools (referred to as Option 6).

Courses

edu-504 - Disciplinary Literacy Instruction and Leadership - 3 hours

edu-529 - Action Research for Teacher Leaders I - 3 hours

edu-531 - Action Research for Teacher Leaders II - 3 hours

edu-641 - Integrated Teaching and Learning I - 3 hours

edu-642 - Integrated Teaching and Learning II - 3 hours

edu-643 - Integrated Teaching and Learning III - 3 hours

edu-644 - Teaching Diverse Learners - 3 hours

edu-645 - Support and Mentoring I - 3 hours

edu-646 - Support and Mentoring II - 3 hours

edu-647 - Capstone Seminar - 3 hours

edu-648 - Secondary Content Teaching Methods - 3 hours

General Education Hours - 0

Elective Hours - 0

Total Hours to Complete - 33
